candidate.name: exact_geometry_grouping
candidate.representation: Bitwise-identical position, LOS direction and displacement-scale signatures are grouped in first-appearance order. Population masses and the complete state-dependent mass/gradient basis are summed per group.

development_protocol.seed_derivation: SHA256(namespace+':'+index) first 8 bytes, masked to 63 bits; ascending indices; collision checked.
development_protocol.fixture: Two exact geometry signatures, each duplicated once; six populations; grid N=8; box=8 cMpc/h.
development_protocol.heldout_split_firewall: No held-out mock was evaluated; candidate and hyperparameters remain development-only.

oracle_validation.q1_candidate_oracle_gate: PASS for all 192 development mocks and all six populations
oracle_validation.interpretation: Exact equality is expected from linearity under bitwise-identical geometry grouping; this does not establish compression for a non-duplicated PM catalog.

agy.summary: The exact-grouping candidate is oracle-equivalent on the executed 192 toy duplicate mocks and Q3.2 resource projections are internally consistent. Promotion is blocked because full-PM compression, end-to-end gradient timing and held-out information gates were not measured.
mandatory_next_checks: Measure grouping on the full 7,077,888-particle N192 basis.
Measure chunked full-field gradient time against the 600-second end-to-end ceiling.
Freeze a viable candidate on development data, then run held-out KL/score/coverage/cellwise gates once.
agy.scope: Document audit plus evidence review; no files or external systems modified.

opus5.summary: The Q3 artifacts are honest development-only results. The 9e-17 equality is a linearity identity for duplicated toy signatures, not evidence of full-PM acceleration; no topology, true gradient, timing or held-out gate was executed.
mandatory_next_checks: Measure real non-duplicated N192 group count and compression ratio.
Run frozen seam/knot/half-box/observer/sigma=2L topology fixtures at L=6 and the 2.0 cMpc/h release geometry.
Test latent-field and bias directional gradient equivalence, including persistent source-basis memory and measured chunk_count timing.
Materialize and assert development/held-out seed disjointness before candidate freeze.
opus5.scope: Read-only document audit; no commands, tests or implementation performed by the auditor.

bundle_audit.scope: Q3.2 read-only resolution/resource preflight and Q3.3 development-only exact grouping; no held-out, posterior, JAX or production claim.
